title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer: CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code on AWS
description: Our SaaS runs on AWS (ECS, RDS, S3), and deploys are manual — only one person on the team knows how to do them. We need a DevOps engineer to move infrastructure to Terraform, build CI/CD in GitHub Actions with Docker, and make staging and production match. Target: any engineer can deploy to production in under 15 minutes. Includes documentation and a handover session with our team. About 6–8 weeks.
